reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off and the cap on how many kids are in at once are exactly what I look for, and the free first visit lets me check it myself before I pay. My 10-month-old is free and there is a gated baby area, so it works for both kids.
objection: Is it actually clean? My toddler puts everything in her mouth. A log is only paper until I see the toys get wiped and the place looks clean when I walk in.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it spotless on my free visit with staff actually cleaning during the session. If it looks grubby or the log looks filled in after the fact, I am out.
